skill_name: Create a rap song about the given subject.
workflow:
[Verse 1]
We need to learn, we need to grow,
From teachers and books, knowledge will flow.
Explore new ideas, never reach a low,
See what life has to offer, with an education to help us go.

[Verse 2]
The hard part's gonna be when you start,
There'll be times when you stumble and you'll fall apart.
But keep going, keep dreaming, don't yield to the lonely dark.
And stand tall, even when you hit the wall.

[Chorus]
Education will show you the way,
Lead you through doubt and show you the way.
